name: RunCam Split HD (DJI HD system)
notes: There is no "Split HD 4K Micro": the RunCam Split HD records up to 2.7K for the DJI digital FPV system (discontinued; RunCam's own page is gone). Retailer spec list: "2.7K@60fps", "Power Input: DC 5V", "Working Current: 450mA@5V(Max)", "Weight: 19.9g", "PCB Size: 29*30mm", "Lens Module Size: 19*19mm". power_W = 5 V x 0.45 A = 2.25 W is DERIVED and is the maximum draw. Height: not published.

name: FLIR Boson 320 Thermal Core
notes: Teledyne FLIR product page: Boson "starting at 7.5 grams", "starting at 600 mW", "<4.9 cm³". Datasheet (third-party copy: https://www.militarysystems-tech.com/sites/militarysystems/files/supplier_docs/Boson%20Datasheet%20-%20Teledyne%20FLIR.pdf): "21 × 21 × 11 mm" and "7.5 g" both WITHOUT lens, "Input Voltage 3.3 VDC", power "as low as 500 mW". The lens is not counted: lens weights are not published, so the real camera is heavier (TODO(source)). The earlier 35 g, 1.2 W, 3.3-5.5 V and 28 mm length had no source and the old URL is dead.

notes: Manufacturer spec page: "265 g", "65×65×60 mm", "6.5 W (average)", "9 ~ 27 V DC". 360-degree FOV compact LiDAR.

name: 500 g cargo pod (design mass, not a product)
notes: NOT A REAL PRODUCT. The earlier record named an "AeroAid 500g Emergency Medical Pod" that does not exist, sourced to a dead WHO page. It is kept only as the medical-run mission's design payload: 500 g is this app's design target for that mission (like the mission's own distance and time), not a measurement. Dimensions: TODO(source), not published (the old 160 x 90 x 80 mm were invented). Replace with a real, published delivery box when one is chosen.

name: MicaSense RedEdge-P Multispectral
notes: Spec page: "363 g (12.8 oz.)" for RedEdge-P + Wi-Fi + CF Express card + DLS2 sun sensor and cables (the flying install), "8.9 x 7.0 x 6.7 cm", "5.5/7.0/10W (standby, average, peak)" (the 7.0 W average is used), external power 7.0-25.2 V.
